decision.explanation: The question asks what position Ernest Leo Unterkoefler currently or formerly holds. From D1S3 and D1S4, it is clear that Unterkoefler is the current leader of the country’s second-largest political party. From D2S2 and D2S10–D2S13, it is stated that he is an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Chicago, with specific details about his ordination and role. The candidate 'auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of Chicago' (C2) provides greater specificity than 'auxiliary bishop' (C1), so it is preferred. Both positions are valid and distinct, and neither contradicts the other.
